limitations: provider change, not a single-variable change: hosted gpt-6.1-sol via ChatGPT plan usage replaces local qwen3:4b/llama3.2:3b, with its own serving stack
client context guard 500000 tokens (OD-13) versus 4096 locally; context policy otherwise unchanged
temperature 0.7, output cap 2048 and seeds are requested but not sent (preview route); provider defaults apply; seeds are cell labels only
reasoning effort not sent (provider default 'low' per the account catalog); hidden reasoning unrecorded and unmeasured beyond reported reasoning_tokens
no weight digest; per-call model versions recorded in provider-ledger.jsonl; the provider may change the model during the campaign
plan metering is opaque; the owner's 10% per-app weekly limit is the only usage cap; a usage-limit stop censors the cell (no replacement)
hosted runs cannot be resumed after interruption; interrupted cells are accounted, never rerun
fixed 600 s / 32-step budgets; hosted calls are faster than local, so step limits rather than deadlines are expected to bind
same-seed replicates are not seeded on the hosted route; they are repeated samples of one prompt, not independent populations (KI-21)
single unmasked Claude reviewer; no independent second rating; reviewer and orchestrator are both large language models from different providers
prompts/cases exposed by S007d/S007h; not an unseen generalisation campaign
runtime source differs from the S007h freeze only on the hosted path (broker token header, provider error codes, broker incl. the S014h in-flight lock fix, adapters)
